summary: Verify on a real Mac that a trackpad pinch zooms the IMAGE, not the whole interface. Ctrl+wheel UI zoom was removed because macOS delivers a pinch as a wheel event with ctrlKey true, so the document-level handler in js/init.js hijacked every pinch into a webFrame zoom. Fix is written and the node suite passes; it is unverifiable on Windows without a precision touchpad and the rented Mac is gone. Blocked on hardware only.

PARKED by the user, waiver recorded. The only deliverable he wants off this card is the release-note entry, and it is already in place - UNRELEASED.md:347, inside the ## fixes section: "Ctrl+scroll no longer changes the size of the interface... That shortcut is gone on every platform". The Mac verification is WAIVED, deliberately and with a reason: the removal itself is platform-wide and checkable on Windows, the bullet claims no verified macOS outcome, and this is a class of bug a user reports within minutes (the user has a tester waiting on 1.4 who will). No Mac is rented for it. This closes as a DECISION, not a verification - nothing was run on macOS and nothing here claims otherwise. MPI-450 Gate B loses its MPI-432 row.

Status field set to 'unverified' alongside maturity 'complete', at the user's direction - the two fields now say different things ON PURPOSE. maturity=complete means the card is closed and off the board; status=unverified records that NOTHING was ever run on macOS. The schema sanctions exactly this (_schema.md: process-specific meaning that is not a valid maturity value is preserved in `status`). Anyone reading this card later must not read 'done' as 'tested'.
